title: Wie komme ich zum Bahnhof
setting: A junction in April, a woman with a suitcase held the way you once held one, and two seconds to answer.

steps.speaker: Eine Frau mit Koffer
steps.es: Entschuldigung, wie komme ich zum Bahnhof?
steps.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

options.es: Da vorne links, dann über die Brücke.
options.en: Left up there, then over the bridge.
options.feedback: Two landmarks and no more. That is what somebody with a suitcase can hold.

options.es: Das ist kompliziert. Ich zeige es Ihnen auf dem Handy.
options.en: That is complicated. I will show you on my phone.
options.feedback: Kind, and it is four minutes long. It is a five minute walk.
She asked you in German. Answering in English is exactly the thing that was done to you for years.
A number. With a suitcase that is the only part of the answer that matters.
Reassuring and useless. She is carrying something and wants to know how long.

options.es: Kommt darauf an, wie schnell Sie gehen.
options.feedback: Technically true. She is standing at a junction with a suitcase.

steps.speaker: Eine Frau mit Koffer
steps.es: Und der Zug nach Zürich, wissen Sie das auch?
steps.en: And the train to Zurich, do you know that too?

options.es: Die fahren etwa alle halbe Stunde.
options.en: They go about every half hour.
options.feedback: Roughly right, said as roughly right. Nobody expects a timetable out of a stranger.

options.es: Um zwölf nach und um zweiundvierzig nach.
options.en: At twelve past and at forty-two past.
options.feedback: You do actually know this. It is also more than she asked for and she will not remember it.

options.es: Das müssen Sie am Schalter fragen.
options.en: You will have to ask at the counter.
options.feedback: Correct and it hands her back to the machine she is trying to avoid.

steps.speaker: Eine Frau mit Koffer
steps.es: Merci vielmal. Sie sind sehr freundlich.
steps.en: Thank you very much. You are very kind.

options.feedback: Take it and let her go. She has a train to catch and you have said the useful things.

options.es: Ich war auch mal neu hier.
options.en: I was new here once too.
options.feedback: True, and it makes the moment about you. She has a suitcase.

options.es: Kein Problem, ich hatte am Anfang die gleichen Probleme.
options.en: No problem, I had the same problems at the beginning.
options.feedback: Two sentences about yourself to somebody who asked for a direction.
